summary: At the base commit, 8 of the 14 new tests fail: every one that expects gpt-5.6-luna as the default. The 6 that pass are the ones where an explicit setting wins, which is already true there.
failed_names: the default OpenAI model OpenAiLLM, which chats use uses the substitute when no model is set
the default OpenAI model OpenAiLLM, which chats use sends the substitute, with the temperature the provider allows it
the default OpenAI model SystemSettings, which the settings screen reads reports the substitute when no model is set
the default OpenAI model the agent providers OpenAIProvider uses the substitute unless given a model
the default OpenAI model the agent providers GenericOpenAiProvider uses the substitute unless given a model
the default OpenAI model AgentHandler.providerDefault uses the substitute when no model is set
the default OpenAI model AgentHandler.createAIbitat uses the substitute when the handler has no model
the default OpenAI model EphemeralAgentHandler.createAIbitat uses the substitute when the handler has no model
passed_names: the default OpenAI model OpenAiLLM, which chats use keeps OPEN_MODEL_PREF when it is set
the default OpenAI model OpenAiLLM, which chats use keeps a workspace's model over OPEN_MODEL_PREF

the default OpenAI model AgentHandler.providerDefault keeps OPEN_MODEL_PREF when it is set
